_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#1. Four runs on the shipped cube at fixed t_end: neo-Hookean converges in ONE load step at 50% and at 300% nominal strain, so the "10 substeps past 10% strain" rule of thumb is wrong by orders of magnitude for a coupled material; Mooney-Rivlin fails in one step at 100% with 'N negative jacobians detected.' and converges in TWO. That last pair is the claim in one comparison — the failure is real, substeps are the fix, and the threshold is material-dependent and nowhere near 10%. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'substep_threshold=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
